description: How a chain actually orders transactions, and therefore which lever wins a mint. Builder-auction chains (Ethereum) sell inclusion, so priority fee moves position. Centralized-sequencer L2s (Base, Arbitrum, OP, Blast, Zora) are first-come-first-served, so raw latency decides and bidding gas mostly burns money. Unclassified chains report unknown rather than guessing.
name: mint_race_inclusion_strategy
